cases.note: A conformance of 0.998125 is 99.8125% exactly — a double, not an approximation — so the third decimal is a tie. `toFixed(3)` takes the larger and prints 99.813; round-half-to-even prints 99.812. Every other field value in this corpus rounds nowhere near a half, so the suspension notice an operator reads was unprotected against a formatter that looked equivalent.
